Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: sharpen.

**What the vignettes add.** Confirms the domain. Adds: a programme is shared state (209e10fb); it is the record of the project and how we learn to use the tools (cd46e937); the aim is to take a concept to delivery without getting lost (4bd4e2d0), with decisions prepped up front so work can be driven automatically and safely (a30aa4cc, 007e1621); the flow section should be updated with discoveries and the high-level archetypal flow mapped (82e8b452, 9826c570). Scale caution 2026-10-25: "we have close to 1000 issues in our repos, with many different tasks", so a suggestion of two epics as the home of work was wrong (6d3da7a8). Note the vignettes on mapping flow touch process more than coordination.

**Proposed.** Keep the work of the SemanticOps and muDemocracy programmes moving to done across many repositories (close to a thousand issues, many kinds of task), with every piece of work understood within the whole picture, so a concept can be taken to delivery without getting lost, with decisions prepared up front and the flow record updated with what we discover.

**Depth.** Moderate-thin: 10 vignettes, mostly touches, 2026-10-25 to 2026-11; some themes are shared with other domains.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
